findings.detail: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud - Compute cost $412.18 in the sample period, 46.2% of the $892.50 total. No Savings Plan or Reserved Instance coverage is recorded in the sample data.
findings.recommendation: Check instance sizes against actual CPU/memory use, and price a Savings Plan for the steady-state baseline before committing.
findings.title: EC2 is 46% of the sample bill

findings.detail: No AWS Budgets alarm is recorded in the sample data, so a cost spike would not trigger an alert.
findings.recommendation: Create a monthly budget alarm at 80% of the expected spend, with an email alert.
findings.title: No budget alarm found

findings.detail: One backup plan was found, but no restore test date is recorded in the sample data. A backup that has never been restored is unproven.
findings.recommendation: Run a restore test into an isolated location, record the result (pass/fail, time taken), and repeat on a schedule.
findings.title: No restore test on record

findings.detail: Vault 'sample-vault' has no lifecycle rule in the sample data, so old recovery points are kept indefinitely.
findings.recommendation: Add a lifecycle rule that moves older recovery points to cold storage and then expires them.
findings.title: Backup vault without a lifecycle rule

findings.detail: Bucket 'sample-public-assets' is recorded as publicly accessible in the sample data.
findings.recommendation: Confirm whether public access is intended. If not, enable Block Public Access on the bucket and check what was exposed.
findings.title: One S3 bucket allows public access

findings.detail: User 'sample-deploy-user' has an active access key that is 214 days old in the sample data.
findings.recommendation: Rotate the key: create a new key, update the workload, confirm it works, then deactivate the old key.
findings.title: Access key older than 90 days still active

findings.detail: Amazon CloudWatch cost $54.32 in the sample period. Log retention is not recorded in the sample data.
findings.recommendation: Check log retention periods and drop verbose log groups to 14 or 30 days where long retention is not needed.
findings.title: CloudWatch is 6% of the sample bill
